routePolicy: Classify the actual path-with-query option: None is absent/null; Some exact full bytes /actions(8) or /action-result(14) is present-target with that literal; every other Some including empty/query/encoded/trailing-slash is present-other/null. No normalization or arbitrary path text emitted. Method GET0/POST2/unknown is independent. Route classification is not endpoint response/status acceptance.

corrState.missing: Independent of method/path: fixed valid literal fields.get returns0 values; corrCount0,corrnull.
corrState.valid: Independent of method/path: exactly1 field-value of64 ASCII0-9/a-f bytes; copied to snapshot; corrCount1 and that value.
corrState.invalid: Independent of method/path: exactly1 other length/shape including empty/uppercase/comma/newline; corrCount1,corrnull.
corrState.duplicate: Independent of method/path: at least2 returned values even identical; corrCount2 saturated,corrnull; no wire-duplicate inference.

ownership: Borrow original incoming-request for metadata; acquire one owned fields child, fields.get returns copied list values, drop fields child immediately on successful getter return, classify/copy only returned slices, then forward original owned request/outparam once. No body resource, request reconstruction, header mutation or uncertain-transfer retry.

memory.allocator: Checked wasm32 realloc(old,oldLen,align,newLen) with power-of-two alignment, unsigned overflow/end checks, min(oldLen,newLen) copy for nonzero-old growth/shrink, zero-size release returning0. Bump/frees reset only at next legal synchronous invocation; no realloc host/WASI calls.

allocatorFailure: Returned method.other/path strings and nested header lists can request arbitrary allocation before classification. The fixed guest bound does not bound host allocation. OOM/invalid allocation can trap BEFORE forwarding, possibly while fields child is live; no successful-forward/fallback/harmlessness guarantee. Resource cleanup of a trapped instance is not inferred.

abi.methodOrder: get0,head1,post2,...,other9; distinct from former native callback POST1.
abi.methodAndPathResult: 12-byte/alignment4 variant or option; discriminantbyte+0,ptr+4,len+8. Sync lower args(request,retptr).
abi.headersResult: own fields directly returned as one i32 canonical handle.
abi.fieldsGetResult: args(fields,namePtr,nameLen,retptr), list pointer+0/count+4; nested byte-list entries stride8/alignment4 pointer+0/length+4.
abi.stdoutResult: result tag1024, stream-error tag1028, own error1032; trailing return pointer.
abi.canonicalOptions: memory+realloc+UTF8 for method/path/fields.get; memory for stdout.write; unchanged simple own-transfer lower/lift.

limits.byteModelScope: 48 finite JSON wire variants in wire-byte-fixtures.json; not WAT/type/host execution.

joinPolicy: Require complete finalized capture and exact V4 typed schema/consistent pathStatus; malformed, lost, limited, unknown-getter or unobserved outcomes remain blocking.
Unknown method blocks the join even if other metadata is available; never infer POST/GET.
Absent path blocks route joining; independently known correlation does not reconstruct its path.
Only proved present-other can be excluded from an exact present-target tuple under this separately reviewed V4 policy. No path/query normalization, guessed routes or retrospective V3 upgrades.

For admitted target POST/actions, require one unique valid/count1 public value equal to the independently Root-declared public correlation value, with actual request/browser/NetLog/public-lane cardinality. Public value is not authentication/private identity.

Otherwise competing invalid/duplicate/unknown or ambiguous target POST candidates conservatively block. Missing/count0 is distinct only after a successful fixed-name getter snapshot; never default unknown to missing.
Known GET observations are distinct; equal values do not establish POST-to-internal-GET causality, physical instance/Store identity, cross-lane order or completion.
All existing V3 unknown records and refused joins remain unchanged; V4 cannot reclassify their discarded path/header facts.
init: Only constants/globals/memory declarations; no core start or imported calls at instantiation. No manifest/environment/clock/entropy/filesystem access.
positiveWitness: Metadata snapshot before transfer plus ordinary code after the exact synchronous imported handler returned, conditional on independently validated new envelope/post-return structure. Not observer own return/post-return, host/TCP/task completion, identity, cause or fullNext.
snapshotPolicy: Ordinary snapshotStatus success means the existing method/path/header/fields.get calls and fields child drop returned normally before the same owned forwarding call, and this record is emitted after that synchronous inner import returned. Getter/canonical allocation/drop/inner traps do not fabricate a normal row. Missing capture cannot identify a specific getter failure.
unknownMethod: Unsupported successfully returned standard method variants remain method unknown. They never become GET/POST and conservatively block joining even when other metadata is available.
unknownGetter: An admission/collection failed-or-unobserved outcome only; no invented recoverable WIT getter error enum, success row, fallback delegation or extra pre-forward I/O.

pathStatusConsistency.present-target: path is one of the two exact literals
pathStatusConsistency.present-other: getter returned Some with a different full byte string; path is null
pathStatusConsistency.absent: getter returned None; path is null; not present-other

models.scope: Inert classifier/byte/allocator/record-cap models, including synthetic None/trap; never fabricated real-host incoming resources.
